official_definition: Nether Unleash: 3 [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks) Send three cores from the opposing Field to the Reserve. For each Spirit depleted by this effect, send an opposing Life to the Reserve. Then, by sending three cores from any Purple Grandwalker Nexuses you control to the Trash, send up to 5 cores from the opposing Reserve to the Trash.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Nether Unleash] or [Nether Unleash: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Nether Unleash]", "give [Nether Unleash]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
